{{Quote|Ko Sai, what other cloning projects have your people worked on?''"<br />"''A number of armies, as well as civilian workforces&mdash;miners for Subterrel, agricultural laborers for Folende, even hazmat workers.|[[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]|<ref name="RC:TC" />}}
'''Folende''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]<ref name="Xim Week" /> located in the [[Folende system/Legends|Folende system]] of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Desevran Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked Folende to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] and [[Omman]]. For [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], Folende's agricultural output was moderate, with Omman being considered its competitor.<ref name="Xim Week" />

In the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] existence, however, Folende's situation changed.<ref name="Xim Week" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', in which the [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] agricultural laborers of Folende are mentioned, to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the world commissioned the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of<ref name="RC:TC" /> the distant world of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to create cloned agricultural laborers.<ref name="RC:TC" /> Folende then experienced a marked rise in production and became an important provider of [[Foodstuff/Legends|staple foods]] to worlds suffering from poverty on the [[Far Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. The circumstances under which Folende increased its amount of produce were considered to be mysterious.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Behind the scenes==
Folende was first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:TC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Folende [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world of Folende, within grid square S-5.<ref name="TEA" />
